facts.subject: Consumer.Group.Heartbeat.Interval
facts.note: Set in NewConfig. Ticker period of the heartbeat loop (consumer_group.go line 1003). The comment at config.go line 303 states (default 3s).

facts.subject: Consumer.Group.Rebalance.Timeout
facts.note: Set in NewConfig. The comment at config.go line 321 states (default 60s).

facts.subject: Consumer.Group.Rebalance.Retry.Max
facts.note: Set in NewConfig. Used as the retry budget for newSession (consumer_group.go line 209).

facts.subject: Consumer.Group.Rebalance.Retry.Backoff
facts.note: Set in NewConfig. Wait before each rejoin retry (consumer_group.go line 252). The comment at config.go line 330 states (default 2s).

facts.subject: Metadata.RefreshFrequency
facts.note: Set in NewConfig; 10 minutes. The comment at config.go line 149 says 0 disables it. Only the group leader runs the partition-count check, which cancels the session when the count changes (consumer_group.go lines 438-439, 699, 717).

facts.subject: Metadata.Retry.Max
facts.note: Set in NewConfig. Also the retry budget of the heartbeat loop when the coordinator cannot be reached (consumer_group.go lines 1009, 1013). Shared with metadata requests.

facts.subject: Metadata.Retry.Backoff
facts.note: Set in NewConfig. Also the heartbeat loop's wait between coordinator retries (consumer_group.go lines 1006, 1017). Shared with metadata requests.

facts.subject: Consumer.Group.Session.Timeout

The mapping to group-coordinator is from those lines together.

facts.subject: Consumer.Group.Rebalance.Timeout
facts.quotedToken: is exceeded, the consumer will be removed from the group by Kafka
facts.note: The file says 'by Kafka' (broker side). The coordinator is not named on this line; same broker group management as the session-timeout fact.

facts.subject: consumerGroupSession.heartbeatLoop
facts.note: Started as its own goroutine in newConsumerGroupSession. The message-consuming ConsumeClaim calls run in separate goroutines (consumer_group.go lines 869-878). The heartbeat ticker waits only on pause.C or hbDying (lines 1059-1063).
